encryption.algorithm: RC4-128 (PDF standard security handler V2 R3)

dependencies: pypdf 6.18.1 (in .venv-qa) - RC4 only, no cryptography wheels needed

provenance.authorship: written by the project team for this spike (ds2); one blank page plus a literal ASCII string, RC4-128 encrypted by pypdf with the /P print bit cleared
provenance.source_documents: none - content is the literal ASCII string PDF4All encrypted no-print

verified_with: mupdf 1.28.1 JS: needsPassword() true, hasPermission('print') false, hasPermission('copy') true, authenticatePassword('pdf4all-user') = 2 then text 'PDF4All encrypted no-print', pypdf 6.18.1 reads /P = 4294965240 (print bit clear)
purpose: P1 unit 5 print permission: an encrypted document that unlocks with a password but forbids printing must report printable=false and refuse the print UI
